tasks.build:audit: deno task audit; deno task build
tasks.build:all: deno task build && deno task build:sw
tasks.check:all: deno task check:format && deno task check:lint && deno task check:content && deno task check:pins && deno task check && deno task build

images:pull.description: Pull cover images from GHCR (digest-pinned, anonymous)

images:push.description: Push src/public/images to GHCR (-- --pin rewrites the digest pin)

images:sync.description: Delta-sync images into _site (only new/changed files transfer)

dev:fast.description: Local build skipping bulk image copy + delta-sync (SKIP_IMAGES=1)
dev:fast.command: SKIP_IMAGES=1 deno task build && deno task images:sync

serve.description: Run and serve the site for development
serve.command: deno task build:sw && deno task lume -s

tasks.deploy: deno task lint && deno task check && deno task build && deno deploy deploy --prod --app deno-lume-portfolio

new.description: Create new content or code using artifacts
